title: TTNOpt: Tree tensor network package for high-rank tensor compression

split.decision: Eq. (32), n=30, L=8, standard variable-major order. Public validation seeds 12345 and 67890; two independently secret-seeded evaluation instances, design stored privately. No cross-instance training; train saves configuration. Dense target observations only, no generating seeds or wavevectors in inputs.

baseline.paper_ref: Table 2 chi=4: 0.39408 averages 21 local auxiliary-bond records; original final dense fidelity 0.2872838954642813.

allowed_changes: Tree topology/orientation, tensors, legal gauge, initialization, factorization/search/update rules, optimization surrogate and implementation.
Any compression algorithm yielding the same admissible TTN certificate; sequential SVD, two-site updates and 100 sweeps are baseline choices.
When retaining the supplied TTNOpt procedure, changing only fidelity.opt_structure.type=1, max_num_sweeps=[100], or setting beta=[0.04,0.02] to zero does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Maximize final-state dense fidelity compressing each supplied 24-leg quantics tensor to a binary TTN with all auxiliary dimensions <=4.
Supplied target tensor, 24 dimension-two physical axes, original bit order and instance distribution.
Binary TTN representation with 22 degree-three nodes, complete physical axes and auxiliary bond dimension <=4.
Final normalized dense-overlap fidelity against the original target, original instance/seed aggregation and isolation.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Change target/axes, raise bond dimensions, output nonbinary/cyclic networks or substitute a dense-copy representation.
Replace final fidelity with averaged local-update records or a self-reported score.
Memorize target solutions, reconstruct hidden seeds or use other evaluation instances.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
